name: clan_of_embers_settler
description: a Clan of Embers Settler: a green-skinned orc with small tusks and a dark topknot, a ragged orange shawl over a dark tunic, a rope belt, a ragged orange-and-dark kilt, steel knee plates and studded brown boots, carrying a huge backpack with a rolled brown bedroll on top and an iron fire-pot with burning flames hanging from it on the screen-left, and gripping a tall wooden walking staff with a steel spear point at its top in his LEFT hand
hands: the spear-tipped staff stays in his left hand on the screen-right side and his right hand on the screen-left side is an empty fist; the big pack with the bedroll and the hanging fire-pot stays on his back

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back, the spear-tipped staff is lifted up over the head with its spear point up and back, the big pack on his back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and slightly crouched, the staff cocked behind the head with its spear point hanging down behind the shoulders, the empty right fist tucked in
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips forward, the arm sweeps over the head and the staff is level, its spear point pointing to the lower-right
strike.4: contact: staff arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the staff's spear point striking down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the empty right fist swung back for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the staff carries on down until its spear point nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the topknot trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the staff lifts back toward its upright resting angle

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the empty right fist flung out to the left, the staff arm thrown up and out), the pack and fire-pot jolting
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the staff tipping, the empty right fist still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, the staff arm flung up, the empty right fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the staff lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the staff's spear point resting on the ground, the empty right arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the staff slips out of the hand, legs slide forward, the heavy pack pulling him back
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back on top of his big pack along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left; the spear-tipped staff lies on the ground at the lower-right; the fire-pot lies beside him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the pack, the bedroll settles
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back on his pack, eyes closed, the staff on the ground beside him
